installation: Registry versions plus committed pnpm patchedDependencies; no local archives or sibling paths required.
verification: pnpm -r --workspace-concurrency=1 check (ten packages) and pnpm -r test pass with these patches applied.

native.resolution: Platform-specific optional dependency from the pinned published TNB package; Windows and Linux use their own addon.

patches.name: @volar/typescript
patches.necessity: Optional for correctness: the ten checks pass without this patch. It is kept because it lowers the peak memory of native checking.
changes: Drop the 4 MiB cap that made module resolution treat files of 4 MiB or more as missing.
Use the CompilerHost text hook to avoid parsing duplicate JavaScript ASTs for native checking.
patches.evidence: Without the hook, gtsc --noEmit over packages/data peaked at 5.83-5.91 GiB working set (3 runs); with the hook, 4.27-4.30 GiB.

patches.name: typescript-native-bridge
patches.necessity: Required: without this patch the pinned package cannot stand in for typescript.

removedCandidates.name: @gi-tcg/gts-language-server
removedCandidates.reason: Belongs to the migration-time editor/backend route that was removed from this repository; the ten package checks and pnpm -r test pass without it.

removedCandidates.name: @gi-tcg/gts-language-plugin
removedCandidates.reason: Only repinned the peer dependency to TNB. The workspace-wide typescript override already supplies that peer, so the patch is redundant here.

removedCandidates.name: @gi-tcg/gts-runtime
removedCandidates.reason: Rewrote a definite-assignment class field. Removing it left all ten checks and pnpm -r test green, so the unpublished runtime fix is not needed for this consumption path.

removedCandidates.name: @gi-tcg/gtsc
removedCandidates.reason: Only repinned the peer dependency to TNB and added an upstream test script. The global typescript override covers the peer; the script is unused here.
